The catalogue lists the number and the gearbox application only — dimension, media and grade are recorded as reference figures A transmission filter's whole job is debris control for the valve body and clutches, so exact model fitment is the gate. From a sourcing view, verify pan-mounted versus external mounting and request media and micron data on the spec sheet.
